_comment: Version floor for desktop apps. The integrity guard (tools/check-desktop-integrity.php) FAILS if a tool's version drops below its baseline here — catching merges that silently revert a desktop version (e.g. GYSS 0.7.9 -> 0.1.5-alpha). When you INTENTIONALLY bump a version, raise it here in the same commit. Never lower a baseline to get past a failure; fix the reverted version instead.
